scope: Host-only NavArenaHeap/NavTileCache reproduction on real completed tile payloads; enforces declared world staging limit. No Detour/query allocations, so available heap is optimistic. Exit zero means the suspected failure was reproduced, not that the dataset passed acceptance.

initialAttempt.reason: Initial assertion also required zero evictions for the entire run; later smaller tiles fill the cache and subsequently trigger slot eviction. Corrected assertion checks eviction count at the first heap-pressure refusal.

assertion: At least one allocation refusal after a successful file read while a free cache slot already existed. Zero means reproduction passed, not dataset acceptance.

secondAttempt.reason: First heap refusal followed a single slot eviction; later refusals occur with free slots. Replaced the overly narrow assertion with the actual pressure failure condition.
